title: Opinion | Can We Keep One Small Corner of America Technology-Free?
snippet: A robot ump, of course, isn’t a robot. That’s just the simplest and most demeaning shorthand I can think of for what Major League Baseball calls A.B.S., the Automated Ball-Strike Challenge System, essentially 12 “Hawk-Eye” cameras snapping photos of every pitch in its flight to the batter. Artificia
